name: reference_bp_v3
relationship_to_v2: v3 is a wrapper module; it imports tools/reference_bp.py and overrides exactly one default (DEFAULT_MAP_SMOOTHING_S 2.0 -> 3.0). tools/reference_bp.py is untouched, so the v1 and v2 records still verify byte for byte.
why: v2 publishes a Preset 2 round whose deflate valve never throttled (peak-window -15.49 mmHg/s) with MAP 202.9 against a panel 116 (+86.9 mmHg). A 3 s median window refuses that round. That is a safety argument, not an accuracy one; the accuracy test is pre-registered and must run on rounds captured after this record.

validity_gate.criterion: peak-window (200-245 mmHg) OLS deflation rate; a capture is unusable when |slope| exceeds DEFLATE_RATE_MAX_MMHG_S
validity_gate.rejected_alternative: a neighbourhood-median ceiling was considered and dropped on measurement: healthy development rounds reach 11.14 mV and healthy prospective rounds reach 10.32 mV, so a 10 mV threshold would refuse valid captures
validity_gate.threshold_provenance: derived from the development set alone, whose maximum |slope| is 2.63 mmHg/s, so 4.0 sits above anything the fixture produces when it works; the two observed failures were 13.35 and 15.49
validity_gate.scope: reads only the pressure trace and never the estimator output, so enabling it cannot bias the estimator error statistics
validity_gate.path_note: moved from tmp\validity_v2.py because tmp/ is gitignored and a freeze record must ship the code it hashes; file content and sha256 are unchanged

baseline_summary.note: the 18 development rounds re-scored with v3; descriptive only. These rounds were used to choose the window, so they can never validate it.

criteria: MAP published rounds >= 0.9 x v2's published count on the same batch
MAP error sd strictly lower than v2 by more than 1.0 mmHg
MAP median |error| not worse than v2 + 1.0 mmHg
count of |error| > 20 mmHg rounds not higher than v2
acceptance_test.verdict_rule: any criterion failing means v3 is abandoned and v2 stays the frozen estimator

exclusion_rules_declared_before_any_v3_r: a round is excluded if the strict decoder rejects it
a round is excluded if preflight rejected it and no inflation occurred
a round is excluded if the MCU reported a fault during the run
a round is excluded if the vent-to-seal closeout did not confirm a sealed zero
a round is excluded if the validity gate marks the capture unusable
a round is flagged but NOT excluded if the estimator refuses it
no round may be excluded because its answer disagrees with the panel
no round from the existing 62 may be counted in the acceptance test
